toolCalls.name: PowerShell

output.text:
Command: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing

$screen = [System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::PrimaryScreen.WorkingArea
$winW = [int]($screen.Width / 2)
$winH = [int]($screen.Height / 2)

$rand = New-Object System.Random
$forms = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[System.Windows.Forms.Form]

try {
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 100; $i++) {
        $f = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Form
        $f.Text = "TestWindow-$($i + 1)"
        $f.Width = $winW
        $f.Height = $winH
        $f.FormBorderStyle = [System.Windows.Forms.FormBorderStyle]::Sizable
        $f.BackColor = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb($rand.Next(256), $rand.Next(256), $rand.Next(256))
        $f.StartPosition = [System.Windows.Forms.FormStartPosition]::Manual
        $f.TopMost = $true
        $x = $rand.Next(0, [Math]::Max(1, $screen.Width - $winW))
        $y = $rand.Next(0, [Math]::Max(1, $screen.Height - $winH))
        $f.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point($x, $y)
        $f.Show()
        $forms.Add($f)
    }

    [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents()

    Write-Output ("Created {0} test windows (size {1}x{2}), topmost, random colors/positions. Holding for 10s..." -f $forms.Count, $winW, $winH)

    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(10)
    while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
        [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents()
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50
    }
}
finally {
    $closed = 0
    foreach ($f in $forms) {
        if ($f -and -not $f.IsDisposed) {
            $f.Close()
            $f.Dispose()
            $closed++
        }
    }
    Write-Output "Closed and disposed $closed test windows."
}
